properties.headline: Special Weather Statement issued July 31 at 4:27PM MDT by NWS Pueblo CO
properties.description:
At 427 PM MDT, Doppler radar was tracking a strong thunderstorm over
Canon City, or 34 miles southwest of Colorado Springs, moving
southeast at 20 mph.

HAZARD...Wind gusts up to 50 mph and pea size hail.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...Gusty winds could knock down tree limbs and blow around
unsecured objects. Minor hail damage to vegetation is
possible.

Locations impacted include...
Florence, Royal Gorge, Canon City, and Penrose.
